title: Cosmic Egg Kick
description: A female martial artist with pale skin and dark hair delivers a high kick while holding a cracked, dripping paint bucket. She battles a green octopus-headed skeleton creature on a cracked pink ground beneath a massive broken eggshell in a starry sky.
prompt: A dynamic surreal scene of a female fighter with long dark ponytail and white martial arts uniform performing a high kick, striking a green octopus monster fused with a white skeleton. She holds a large cracked paint bucket spilling orange liquid. They stand on cracked pink ground with colorful flowers and fruit slices. Behind them is a giant cracked white eggshell dripping red and orange liquid against a starry cosmic night sky, vibrant colors, detailed painting style.
